summary:
Recent headlines reflect ongoing advocacy concerns about federal control over D.C.'s governance and security, including debates over National Guard deployment in the District and renewed calls from lawmakers to prioritize statehood legislation. These discussions underscore longstanding tensions between local D.C. governance and federal oversight.

Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.

articles.title: Why we shouldn’t have National Guard Troops in D.C.
